failures.root_cause: is_paper() and is_dry_run() guards exist only in Mt5ExecutionAdapter.execute (adapters/mt5_execution.py:44-86). KillSwitch._close_all_positions, PositionRecoveryService, and Mt5PositionManager partial/trail/close paths call mt5.order_send without paper/dry-run checks. PositionManager checks dry_run only (lines 304,363,392), not TRADINGBOT_PAPER.
failures.detection: grep order_send outside mt5_execution; mode_label() vs actual broker activity; unexpected deals in MT5 history while --paper or --loop dry-run
failures.recovery: Manual stop bot; verify MT5 deals; use --no-recovery; disable kill switch via EMERGENCY_STOP_ENABLED=false
failures.manual_recovery: Stop LiveRunner; review/close unintended positions in MT5 terminal

failures.root_cause: check_entry_allowed() references undefined name `config` when computing daily loss budget: `(config or {}).get(...)`. Parameter list (lines 138-147) has no config argument.
failures.detection: NameError in RiskStage on any entry attempt after cooldown/max-trades gates pass; kernel journal state=blocked
failures.recovery: No runtime workaround; RiskStage exception breaks pipeline for that market cycle (kernel/trading_kernel.py:190-193)
failures.manual_recovery: Code fix required before live risk path is usable

failures.root_cause: USE_ML_KERNEL defaults false via _env_bool. build_strategy_registry returns LegacyStrategyRegistry unless env USE_ML_KERNEL=1.
failures.detection: MLKernelRegistry.last_source=legacy; no ml_kernel metadata on signals; missing USE_ML_KERNEL in environment
failures.recovery: Set USE_ML_KERNEL=1 before start; verify MLKernelRegistry.stats()
failures.manual_recovery: Export USE_ML_KERNEL=1 in launch script or .env

failures.root_cause: _mt5_ready short-circuit returns True when mt5.terminal_info() is truthy without re-checking terminal.connected. Stale flag persists until shutdown() clears it (line 110).
failures.detection: Empty/stale OHLCV while ensure_connected returns True; copy_rates_from_pos returns None warnings
failures.recovery: ensure_mt5_connected in mt5_utils re-validates connected flag on execution path; market_data may serve stale parquet until fetch fails
failures.manual_recovery: Restart LiveRunner; restart MT5 terminal

failures.root_cause: check_mt5_health returns connected=True for stale ticks (age > max_tick_age_sec). TradingKernel logs warning but continues cycle without abort.
failures.detection: Log: MT5 health warning: stale tick; weekend/market-close tick age
failures.recovery: Cycle continues; next bar may refresh; manual stop during closed market
failures.manual_recovery: Do not run during market close/weekend without explicit gate

failures.root_cause: KernelFallbackError and any Exception trigger silent fallback to LegacyStrategyRegistry without halting kernel.
failures.detection: fallback_count increment; log ML kernel fallback; signal metadata signal_source=legacy_fallback
failures.recovery: Fix root cause (health, timeout, empty unified frame); FallbackMonitor logs
failures.manual_recovery: Inspect health_gate checks; reduce pipeline latency

failures.root_cause: Feature cache key is symbol:timeframe:len:last_index only. Omits dataset file fingerprint/content fingerprint. DatasetStore.load_v2 on disk change may serve stale unified features until last bar timestamp changes.
failures.detection: Fingerprint mismatch in health_gate vs cached predictions; manifest update without process restart
failures.recovery: PipelineCache.reset() or process restart; DatasetMemoryCache invalidates on file fingerprint change but PipelineCache feature cache does not
failures.manual_recovery: Restart process after dataset/bundle updates

failures.root_cause: PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS=500. Elapsed >500ms raises KernelFallbackError → legacy fallback. Phase24A measured ~11% pipeline timeouts at p95 ~808ms.
failures.detection: pipeline_timeout in logs; FallbackMonitor; phase24a/runtime_statistics.json pipeline_timeouts=12
failures.recovery: Automatic legacy fallback; latency optimizations (24G/24I) reduce but do not eliminate
failures.manual_recovery: Profile unified frame build; ensure USE_ML_KERNEL with healthy bundles

failures.root_cause: sync_from_mt5 rebuilds daily_pnl and consecutive_losses from deals but NOT trades_today or last_entry_utc_by_tf. record_entry only called after live order_send success (mt5_execution.py:190-193), not in paper mode.
failures.detection: live_risk_state.json trades_today=0 after restart mid-session; paper mode never increments counters
failures.recovery: Persisted state partial; manual review of deal history
failures.manual_recovery: Reset state file or enforce external trade count audit

failures.root_cause: _sync_mt5_account swallows all exceptions. On MT5 failure retains last known balance/positions silently.
failures.detection: Stale open_positions count vs MT5 terminal; risk decisions on outdated equity
failures.recovery: Next successful sync on following cycle if MT5 reconnects
failures.manual_recovery: Verify MT5 connection; compare positions_get with risk gate snapshot

failures.root_cause: _last_closed_bar is in-memory dict per process. Restart or second instance duplicates signal evaluation on same closed bar.
failures.detection: Duplicate journal entries same bar timestamp after restart; compare cycle logs
failures.recovery: None within process; relies on execution-layer position checks
failures.manual_recovery: Single LiveRunner instance; --no-recovery if duplicate managers

failures.root_cause: _registry is in-memory only. After restart partial TP hits, trailing baseline, and initial_risk are recomputed from current SL/ATR — continuity loss.
failures.detection: Re-registered ticket in _register_if_new; partial TP levels reset hits array
failures.recovery: PositionRecoveryService DB may partially overlap if enabled (separate code path)
failures.manual_recovery: Manual SL review after restart; --no-recovery to avoid dual managers

failures.root_cause: BackgroundServices enables PositionRecoveryService by default (enable_recovery=True). Kernel also runs Mt5PositionManager.manage_all each cycle. PositionProtector optional but recovery always active unless --no-recovery.
failures.detection: Conflicting trailing/partial close logs from [POS_MGR] and [RECOVERY]
failures.recovery: Use --no-recovery for kernel-only management
failures.manual_recovery: Disable recovery service; single manager policy

failures.root_cause: _order_send_with_retry retries once on retcodes 10004,10006,10007,10010,10021,10031 with reconnect and repriced request. No idempotency token — transient success after partial broker state could duplicate.
failures.detection: Duplicate tickets same magic/comment; retcode logs
failures.recovery: Manual reconcile MT5 positions
failures.manual_recovery: Verify positions_get before retry policy change

failures.root_cause: Paper path returns simulated fill without record_live_entry(). Cooldown and max-trades counters not updated in paper mode.
failures.detection: live_risk_state.json unchanged after paper fills; over-trading vs configured limits in paper
failures.recovery: None in code
failures.manual_recovery: Treat paper risk metrics as non-authoritative

failures.root_cause: Pre-decision health validates dataset_fingerprint and checksums at adapter start. Mismatch raises KernelFallbackError — not hard stop. Wrong-model trading possible via legacy path.
failures.detection: health_gate checks false; fallback events; bundle_monitor alerts
failures.recovery: Replace/fix bundles; align EXPECTED_DATASET_FINGERPRINT
failures.manual_recovery: Halt if fingerprint mismatch — do not rely on fallback for production ML

failures.root_cause: No file locking on read/write. Concurrent writers or disk-full during to_parquet fails silently (debug log only). Corrupt/missing cache returns None — may trigger MT5 fetch or empty pipeline.
failures.detection: Cache read failed debug logs; empty enriched_ohlcv in SignalStage
failures.recovery: Delete corrupt parquet; refetch from MT5
failures.manual_recovery: Monitor disk space; single writer process

failures.root_cause: _save writes JSON without file lock. KillSwitch thread and main asyncio loop can interleave reads/writes with sync_from_mt5 and record_entry.
failures.detection: Corrupt live_risk_state.json; JSON parse fallback to empty state in _load
failures.recovery: _load exception returns fresh LiveRiskSnapshot — resets risk counters
failures.manual_recovery: Backup state file; single-writer discipline

failures.root_cause: sqlite3.connect per call without WAL/busy_timeout documented. Concurrent writes from execution and position manager journal lookups may raise OperationalError (uncaught in some paths).
failures.detection: SQLite locked errors in logs; missing execution records
failures.recovery: Retry on next cycle
failures.manual_recovery: Enable WAL; serialize journal writes

failures.root_cause: validate_order checks lot>0 and price>0 but not broker volume_min/step or stop level distance. Broker retcodes returned as ExecutionResult success=False — no auto resize.
failures.detection: Order rejected logs; retcode in execution message
failures.recovery: Manual lot/SL adjustment; next signal cycle
failures.manual_recovery: Configure MIN_LOT/MAX_LOT; verify symbol_info stops_level

failures.root_cause: check_spread_gate blocks entry when spread_pips > max. Missing tick returns 999.0 pips — blocks trade (safe). Spread spike mid-fill not re-checked at execution.
failures.detection: Risk blocked: spread; slippage in execution journal
failures.recovery: Next cycle re-evaluates
failures.manual_recovery: Widen max spread config if appropriate

failures.root_cause: Success on TRADE_RETCODE_DONE or TRADE_RETCODE_PLACED without verifying filled volume vs requested lot.
failures.detection: Compare result.volume vs request volume in MT5 deal history
failures.recovery: Manual top-up or accept partial exposure
failures.manual_recovery: Audit deals in MT5

failures.root_cause: Single retry reconnect on order failure. Global cycle skips if ensure_connected fails (trading_kernel.py:128-133). Intermittent IPC may drop single cycle only.
failures.detection: Skipping cycle — MT5 not connected; order_send returned None
failures.recovery: Automatic retry next cycle interval
failures.manual_recovery: Restart MT5 terminal if persistent -10004

failures.root_cause: Friday gate blocks new entries. EOD/Friday close in position manager can send real close orders. Stale tick path (AUD-005) may still evaluate signals on old data if health passes.
failures.detection: friday gate logs; stale tick warnings; market closed
failures.recovery: Wait for session open; disable bot on weekends
failures.manual_recovery: Schedule LiveRunner; verify EOD_CLOSE settings

failures.root_cause: LiveRiskTracker uses UTC date for day reset. KillSwitch uses KILL_SWITCH_DAY_RESET_HOUR_UTC configurable. Misalignment between kill switch daily loss and tracker daily_pnl if configs differ.
failures.detection: daily counters reset at unexpected wall time; broker report vs bot state
failures.recovery: Align reset hour config across services
failures.manual_recovery: Document broker timezone vs UTC reset

failures.root_cause: symbol_select failure logged as warning during connect. symbol_info None aborts order with message. resolve_broker_symbol mapping error may target wrong symbol.
failures.detection: Failed to select symbol; Symbol not found execution result
failures.recovery: Fix symbol map in config; add to Market Watch manually
failures.manual_recovery: Verify broker symbol suffix (_i etc.)

failures.root_cause: Prediction cache keyed by row_key without bundle version in key. Engine/bundle version change during long uptime may return stale prediction until row_key changes.
failures.detection: resolve_bundle_version change without PipelineCache.reset
failures.recovery: Process restart clears caches
failures.manual_recovery: Call PipelineCache.reset() after bundle deploy

failures.root_cause: Lock held during get_unified_frame including build_unified_frame + DatasetStore.load_v2. Long hold blocks other markets/threads. Not incorrect but latency amplification under contention.
failures.detection: Latency spikes multi-symbol; thread wait on _lock
failures.recovery: Release lock scope optimization (not implemented)
failures.manual_recovery: Single symbol/timeframe for paper pilot

failures.root_cause: _loop catches all Exception at debug level — repeated account read failures may delay kill switch trigger without critical visibility.
failures.detection: KillSwitch check error debug lines; missing trigger under drawdown
failures.recovery: MT5 reconnect restores _read_account
failures.manual_recovery: Monitor equity externally

failures.root_cause: EMERGENCY_STOP is in-memory KernelState only. Process restart clears emergency stop — bot may resume trading after kill switch event.
failures.detection: Restart after kill switch; kernel state RUNNING again
failures.recovery: Manual intervention required before restart
failures.manual_recovery: Do not auto-restart after kill switch; set manual_stop flag

failures.root_cause: load_v2 failure propagates as empty unified frame → KernelFallbackError unified_frame_empty or legacy fallback. No automatic dataset repair in live path.
failures.detection: unified_frame_empty; missing dataset_v2 parquet
failures.recovery: Rebuild dataset offline; restart with valid artifact
failures.manual_recovery: Restore dataset from known fingerprint backup

failures.root_cause: update_all raises ConnectionError if ensure_connected fails — uncaught in run_global_cycle may abort cycle with exception unless outer handler exists. run_forever loop continues after sleep.
failures.detection: ConnectionError in logs; skipped cycles
failures.recovery: Next interval retries connection
failures.manual_recovery: Check network/VPN to broker

failures.root_cause: manage_open_positions is read-only count. RiskGate loads positions from MT5 each evaluate. Open positions persist at broker — bot does not auto-close on startup unless recovery/protector rules fire.
failures.detection: positions_get on startup; orphan positions vs registry empty
failures.recovery: PositionRecoveryService reconciles if enabled
failures.manual_recovery: Manual flat before paper session; verify magic 234000 positions

failures.root_cause: No bar-level execution dedup. If SignalStage dedup bypassed (restart), ExecutionStage always calls executor.execute.
failures.detection: Duplicate executions same bar timestamp in journal
failures.recovery: RiskGate max positions may block second entry
failures.manual_recovery: Rely on check_no_opposite_position and max positions

failures.root_cause: order_check retcode 10027 detected by check_autotrading_ready but not called in TradingKernel global cycle — only check_mt5_health for tick age.
failures.detection: Live orders fail retcode 10027; preflight not in hot path
failures.recovery: Enable Algo Trading Ctrl+E in MT5
failures.manual_recovery: Run check_autotrading_ready before --execute session
